text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein to address opening session of parliament on November 19.

- King Hussein and Indonesian President Suharto to discuss bilateral relations and regional issues on Tuesday. On Monday he met Turkish Foreign Minister Ciller, affirmed importance of Turkey's role in supporting stability in region.
- Armed attack on Jordanian embassy car in Iraq. Driver killed, diplomatic bag stolen.
- High-placed sources expect amnesty within 24 hours for remaining detainees from bread riots. Sources say there are no political prisoners in Jordan.
- Jordan and Turkey hold talks on military cooperation, fighting terrorism, and aim to lift sanctions on Iraq.
- Supply Minister Sobar says vegetable and fruit prices will be liberalised after Ramadan (February 1997).
- Senior Jordanian military official calls on Israel to discuss nuclear disarmament with Arabs.
